# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting ZeroCode via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/feelmypain/zerocode/security/advisories/new). Please do not disclose them publicly until
we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and [github.com/feelmypain/zerocode](https://github.com/feelmypain/zerocode)
for the security model, scope, and reporting details.
